# octoreview-go

> Official Go SDK for Octoreview: multi-tenant reviews, ratings and review media. Part of the octoverse family, modelled on octonomy. Status: bootstrapped; release
> line 1 in progress.

Gates: `make check` (fast, toolchain only) and `make release-check` (full). `make help` lists
every target.

## Docs

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): product rules, gates and the development pipeline
- [README](README.md): install, usage, errors and the retry table
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): layout, the offline contract gate and why models are hand-written
- [Vendored contract](testdata/contract/SOURCE): the server commit the contract gate checks against
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Release runbook](docs/release.md)
- [Versioning policy](docs/versioning.md)
- [Rulesets](.github/rulesets/README.md): the live rulesets' reviewable mirror
